HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

8. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

12. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   C. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Digital divide and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Inclusivity and Interdependence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. C — Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Plan income and spending wisely

5. B — Nairobi

6. C — Explain symbols used on a map

7. C — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
